infotexts.entitydescription.aegisservosuit: Exosuit rated to 10,000 m. Slots: battery, ammunition, servo, impeller, compressor and oxygen tank. The arm, thruster, sonar and light require a battery. The suit draws from the tank underwater. The compressor refills the tank in breathable air. Craft modules separately. Requires client and server LuaCs.
infotexts.aegis.title: Servo arm
infotexts.aegis.grab_help: Point at the target. Hold [InputType.Aim] and press [InputType.Use], then release the keys. The claw holds one loose object or creature, living or dead. Acquisition range is 300. The claw keeps its grip at obstacles. Press again while aiming to release. Changing mode, losing power, removing the suit or moving beyond holding range releases the grip.
infotexts.aegis.hide_panel: Hide panel; the function stays enabled
infotexts.entitydescription.aegiscompressormodule: Install in suit slot 5 and put an oxygen tank in slot 6. The compressor uses battery power to refill a standard tank in dry, breathable air.
